title: Robotic Process Automation Engineer
description:
About Us

Stellantis &You is a leading manufacturer-owned dealership group with people at the heart of everything we do. Our colleagues are the driving force behind our success, living our values every day and delivering outstanding service to our customers.

We're passionate about helping our people grow. Whether you're looking to develop new skills or progress your career, you'll be supported every step of the way with excellent development opportunities.

Recently recognised as a Best Company "Ones to Watch" organisation, there's never been a better time to join Stellantis &You and become part of our journey.

Why Join Stellantis &You?

Here at Stellantis &You, our rewards package is about much more than just salary. While we offer a competitive salary and recognise high performance, we also provide a wide range of additional benefits designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance, and career development:

  • Competitive Salary
  • 26 days holidays + bank holidays (Additional day for every 5 years of service)
  • Employee Car Scheme
  • Employer Pension Contributions
  • Rewards Gateway Discounts on High Street & Online Retailers
  • Work with One of the World's Leading Automotive Brands

The Opportunity

Salary - £36,000 - £42,000

Closing Date - 15/11/2026

Stellantis &You, the retail division of Stellantis, is looking for an experienced RPA Developer to join our Head Office Process Improvement Team.

In this exciting role, you will play a key part in driving business transformation across the organisation by designing, developing, and implementing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions using Microsoft Power Automate Desktop. Your work will help streamline processes, improve operational efficiency, and automate interactions with systems that do not offer direct API integration.

Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, and Administration, you will help identify opportunities for automation and deliver innovative solutions that enhance the day-to-day experience of over 1,500 colleagues across our business.

As part of the Process Improvement Team, you will be involved in the full automation lifecycle, from gathering requirements and analysing business processes to designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining automation workflows. You will collaborate with business analysts, developers, and key stakeholders to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that create measurable business value.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a forward-thinking team at a time when automation and digital transformation are playing an increasingly important role in how we operate. If you are passionate about technology, problem-solving, and delivering impactful business improvements, we'd love to hear from you.

You will gain experience in the following disciplines:

  • Technical Project Management
  • Business Analysis
  • Solution Architecture and Design
  • Working in an exciting, fast moving environment utilising low or No Code App building technologies & Robotic Process Automation platforms

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum of two years' experience working with Power Automate Desktop
  • Experience designing and implementing business process automation
  • Understanding of APIs, system integrations and data transformation
  • Exposure to problem solving using computers using either programming or low/no code solutions
  • A keen interest in technology and automation
  • Good analytical, problem solving, and attention to detail skills.
  • A high level of motivation and initiative
  • A team player attitude and excellent communication skills
  • A full UK Driving Licence

Desirable but not Essential:

  • Minimum of two years' experience working with any Process Automation Platform such as Make.com, Power Automate, n8n, Zapier
  • Some exposure to automation technology or programming languages such as JavaScript
  • Some exposure to Apify or other Web Based Website scraping solutions
  • Basic knowledge of AWS & Virtual Machines
  • Some knowledge of database systems such as Oracle, SQL Server or MySQL

Stellantis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or gender identity. Stellantis are also accredited with the Defence Employer Recognition Scheme (ERS) Gold Award, that recognises organisations that pledge, demonstrate or advocate support to the armed forces community.

Please contact our recruitment team if you would like to discuss anything further or if you require any form of reasonable adjustments for any part of the recruitment process.

Join Stellantis & You and build your future with a business where People come first, Pride drives excellence, Performance creates opportunity, and Praise celebrates success.
